{{Top|leg}}
A '''Deflector-Shield Overload Damper''' was part of the systems installed on the [[Tenloss Syndicate/Legends|Tenloss Syndicate's]] [[Hornet-class interceptor|''Hornet''-class interceptor]]. The dampers were fitted under the wings of the interceptor, and above the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield projectors]].<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
